disclaimer: Lab protocols. Customer claims require Layer-C Audit re-measurement. Not LoCoMo SOTA.

U1.name: Non-isolated multimodal body
U1.one_liner: One incubating body shares modality better than isolated late fusion.
U1.pass_bar: shared_patch margin ≥ +0.02 and win rate threshold

U2.name: Fate-gated abstain / proactive
U2.one_liner: Emit when on-topic; abstain when evidence mismatches.
U2.bound: Not a guarantee of zero production incidents.

U3.name: Zero-weight pollution rescue
U3.one_liner: Transfer from structure snapshot rescues accuracy vs polluted dump — without LM fine-tune.
U3.bound: Advantage is pollution rescue, not beating clean RAG/trad_lm on this slice.

U4.name: Backbone-orthogonal structure path
U4.one_liner: Swap the LM decode head; structural state path can remain.

U5.name: Cost at accuracy floor
U5.one_liner: Cheaper prefill while staying on-topic vs full RAG re-inject.
U5.bound: Residual off-topic turns allowed under floor.

steps.label: Persistent state
steps.detail: Incubate structural session body outside the chat window.

steps.label: Inject false fact
steps.detail: Pollute retrieval / summary with a contradictory claim.

steps.label: Naive path fails
steps.detail: Full dump keeps driving later answers from corruption.

steps.label: Valhalla recovers
steps.detail: Transfer / re-anchor on structure snapshot — no LM SGD.

steps.label: Under-specified ask
steps.detail: Tool action requested without sufficient grounded evidence.

steps.label: Abstain
steps.detail: Refuse false action instead of inventing a tool call.

steps.label: Structure body
steps.detail: Session state lives outside LM weights.

steps.label: Path remains
steps.detail: Native / open structure path stays usable.
